description: This Java class 'MongoMetrics' defines a data structure for capturing metrics related to MongoDB performance, specifically maximum timer durations and their reporting details. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and converting to JSON.

classes.name: MongoMetrics
classes.description: Immutable class that holds metrics related to MongoDB operation timings, including reporter info, resolution, and max timer data. Provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and instance creation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new MongoMetrics instance from provided reporter, resolution, and timer data.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to instantiate a MongoMetrics object.

methods.name: getMaxTimerNanos
methods.description: Returns the list of maximum timer durations in nanoseconds.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MongoMetrics instance into a JSON object.
